```{r setup}
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(pheatmap)
library(tidyverse)
library(eulerr)
```

```{r data and helpers}
source("scripts/main-data.R")
source("scripts/helpers.R")

# a prism-like ggplot2 theme

theme_prismLike = theme_bw() +
    theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(-0.15, "cm"),
    axis.ticks.y.right = element_line(),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.6)
  )
```

```{r heatmap of 936 il1b upreg genes, fig.height=7, fig.width=5}
goi_up = dea %>%
  filter(
    FDR <= 0.05,
    log2fold >= 1
  ) %>%
  pull(Gene) %>%
  unique()

up_mat = mat[goi_up, ]

colsplits = factor(
  c(
    rep("WT", 4),
    rep("sham", 4),
    rep("TAK1KO", 4),
    rep("KO + lipid", 4),
    rep("rescue", 4),
    rep("mutant rescue", 4)
  ),
  levels = c(
    "WT",
    "sham",
    "TAK1KO",
    "KO + lipid",
    "rescue",
    "mutant rescue"
  )
)

# ===== original (robust colorscale, 98% quantile clipping) =====

colors = generic_l2f_heatmap_colors(
  up_mat
)

Heatmap(
  up_mat,
  col = colors,
  name = "log2fold",
  column_split = colsplits,
  cluster_columns = F,
  show_row_names = F,
  show_column_names = F,
  column_title_rot = 45,
  show_row_dend = F,
  use_raster = T
)


# ===== symmetric colorscale, no clipping =====

colors = generic_l2f_heatmap_colors(
  up_mat,
  scaleType = "symmetric",
  clipFactor = 1
)

Heatmap(
  up_mat,
  col = colors,
  name = "log2fold",
  column_split = colsplits,
  cluster_columns = F,
  show_row_names = F,
  show_column_names = F,
  column_title_rot = 45,
  show_row_dend = F,
  use_raster = T
)

# ===== symmetric colorscale, 99.5% clipping =====

colors = generic_l2f_heatmap_colors(
  up_mat,
  scaleType = "symmetric",
  clipFactor = 0.995
)

Heatmap(
  up_mat,
  col = colors,
  name = "log2fold",
  column_split = colsplits,
  cluster_columns = F,
  show_row_names = F,
  show_column_names = F,
  column_title_rot = 45,
  show_row_dend = F,
  use_raster = T
)

# ===== symmetric colorscale, 98% clipping =====

colors = generic_l2f_heatmap_colors(
  up_mat,
  scaleType = "symmetric",
  clipFactor = 0.98
)

Heatmap(
  up_mat,
  col = colors,
  name = "log2fold",
  column_split = colsplits,
  cluster_columns = F,
  show_row_names = F,
  show_column_names = F,
  column_title_rot = 45,
  show_row_dend = F,
  use_raster = T
)

cleanup_objects()
```

```{r volcano plots for each condition, fig.height=8, fig.width=3, dpi=600}
df = dea %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = unique(group))) %>%
  mutate(logFDR = -log10(FDR)) %>%
  mutate(logFDR = if_else(is.infinite(logFDR), 325, logFDR))

ggplot(
  df,
  aes(x = log2fold, y = logFDR)
) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~group, 
    ncol = 1,
    axes = "all",
    labeller = labeller(
      group = c(
        "WT_naive" = "wt",
        "sham_naive" = "sham",
        "TAK1KO_naive" = "KO",
        "TAK1KO_lipid" = "KO+lipid",
        "TAK1KO_TAK1-smRNA" = "KO+nat",
        "TAK1KO_mTAK1-smRNA" = "KO+D175A"
      )
    )
    ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(fill = sig),
    size = 0.8,
    shape = 21,
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.25
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", lwd = 0.25) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed", lwd = 0.25) +
  theme_prismLike +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none"
    ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("up" = "firebrick1", "ns" = "grey", "dn" = "steelblue1")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.15, 0.15)),
    limits = c(0, 350),
    breaks = c(0, 100, 200, 300)
    ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = 0.2),
    breaks = c(-5, 0, 5, 10)
  ) +
  labs(x = "log2fold", y = "-log10(FDR)")

df %>%
  select(group, sig) %>%
  count(group, sig)
```


```{r violin on 738 wt-upreg DEGs in each condition, fig.width=3, fig.height=2}
wt_up_738 = dea %>% 
  filter(condition == "WT", sig == "up") %>% 
  pull(Gene)

df = tpm %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = unique(group))) %>%
  filter(Gene %in% wt_up_738, treatment == "IL1B") %>%
  select(Gene, group, log2fold) %>%
  group_by(Gene, group) %>%
  summarize(log2fold = mean(log2fold), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(
  df,
  aes(x = group, y = log2fold)
) +
  geom_violin(scale = "width", lwd = 0.4, color = "black") +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.3, outliers = F, lwd = 0.4, color = "black") +
  # geom_jitter(width = 0.3, alpha = 0.1, size = 0.8) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  ) +
  theme_prismLike +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 0.5)

ggsave("violin.png", h = 2, w = 3, dpi = 600)

df = df %>%
  mutate(
    group = case_when(
      group == "WT_naive" ~ "wt",
      group == "sham_naive" ~ "sham",
      group == "TAK1KO_naive" ~ "ko",
      group == "TAK1KO_lipid" ~ "lipid",
      group == "TAK1KO_TAK1-smRNA" ~ "nat",
      group == "TAK1KO_mTAK1-smRNA" ~ "D175A"
    )
  )

violin_tukey = aov(log2fold~group, df) %>%
  TukeyHSD() %>%
  .$group %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("comparison") %>%
  mutate(sig = case_when(
    `p adj` <= 0.001                    ~ "***",
    `p adj`  <= 0.01 & `p adj`  > 0.001    ~ "**",
    `p adj`  <= 0.05 & `p adj`  > 0.01     ~ "*",
    `p adj`  > 0.05                     ~ "ns")
  ) %>%
  arrange(comparison)

violin_df = df %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "group", values_from = "log2fold")

writexl::write_xlsx(
  list(
    "log2fold_tpm" = violin_df,
    "tukey" = violin_tukey
  ),
  "data/wt_up_738-folds-allConditions.xlsx"
  )
```

```{r pca on tpms}

# wt_up_738
goi = dea %>%
  filter(
    # group == "WT_naive",
    # sig == "up"
    FDR <= 0.05,
    abs(log2fold) >= 1
  ) %>%
  pull(Gene) %>%
  unique()

# build matrix
pc_mat <- tpm %>%
  filter(
    Gene %in% goi,
    treatment %in% c("NS", "IL1B")
    ) %>%
  mutate(sample = paste0(condition, "_", rescue, "_", treatment, "_", rep)) %>%
  select(Gene, sample, log2tpm) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = sample, values_from = log2tpm) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Gene") %>%
  as.matrix()

# PCA
pca <- prcomp(t(pc_mat), center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)

# PCA values dataframe
pc_df <- as.data.frame(pca$x) %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
  separate(
    sample, 
    into = c("condition","rescue","treatment", "rep"), 
    sep = "_",
    remove = F
  ) %>%
  mutate(sample2 = paste0(condition, "_", rescue, "_", rep)) %>%
  mutate(
    treatment = factor(treatment, levels = c("NS", "IL1B")),
    condition = factor(condition, levels = c("WT", "sham", "TAK1KO"))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    id = case_when(
      str_detect(sample, "WT_naive") ~ "wt",
      str_detect(sample, "sham_naive") ~ "sham",
      str_detect(sample, "TAK1KO_naive") ~ "KO",
      str_detect(sample, "TAK1KO_lipid") ~ "lipid",
      str_detect(sample, "TAK1KO_TAK1-smRNA") ~ "nat",
      str_detect(sample, "TAK1KO_mTAK1-smRNA") ~ "D175A" 
    ),
    id = factor(id, levels = unique(id)),
    .before = 1
  )

# variation explained by each pc
pca_var <- (pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2)) * 100
pca_var <- pca_var %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  setNames("variance_explained") %>%
  mutate(
    PC = paste0("PC", row_number()),
    cumulative_variance = cumsum(variance_explained)
  ) %>%
  select(PC, variance_explained, cumulative_variance)

# across-replicate centroids
pc_centroids <- pc_df %>%
  group_by(condition, rescue, treatment) %>%
  summarise(across(starts_with("PC"), mean), .groups = "drop")

# per-replicate distances from NS
pc_distance <- pc_df %>%
  select(condition, rescue, treatment, rep, PC1, PC2) %>%
  left_join(
    pc_df %>%
      filter(treatment == "NS") %>%
      select(condition, rescue, rep, PC1, PC2) %>%
      rename(PC1_NS = PC1, PC2_NS = PC2),
    by = c("condition", "rescue", "rep")
  ) %>%
  filter(treatment != "NS") %>%
  mutate(
    dist = sqrt(
      (PC1 - PC1_NS)^2 + (PC2 - PC2_NS)^2
    )
  ) %>%
  select(condition, rescue, treatment, rep, dist) %>%
  mutate(
    group = paste0(condition, "_", rescue),
    group = factor(group, levels = unique(group))
  )

# per-replicate distance, Tukey's HSD
tukey = pc_distance %>%
  select(group, dist) %>%
  aov(dist ~ group, data = .) %>%
  TukeyHSD() %>%
  .$group %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("comparison") %>%
  select(comparison, pval = `p adj`) %>%
  mutate(
  sig = case_when(
    pval <= 0.001  ~ "***",
    pval <= 0.01   ~ "**",
    pval <= 0.05   ~ "*",
    TRUE           ~ "ns"
  )
)

# PCA loadings for each gene
pca_loadings <- as.data.frame(pca$rotation) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Gene") %>%
  select(Gene, PC1, PC2) %>%
  mutate(
    PC1_contribution = PC1^2 / sum(PC1^2) * 100,
    PC2_contribution = PC2^2 / sum(PC2^2) * 100
  )

# cleanup_objects()
```

```{r what drives the upward shift along pc2?}

# get rescue-unique 118 genes
unique_to_rescue = setdiff(
  dea %>% filter(group == "TAK1KO_TAK1-smRNA", sig == "up") %>% pull(Gene),
  dea %>% filter(group == "WT_naive", sig == "up") %>% pull(Gene)
)


# rank pc2 loadings and check if in 118
df_rescue <- pca_loadings %>%
  select(Gene, PC2) %>%
  arrange(desc(PC2)) %>%
  mutate(
    rank = row_number(),
    in_set = Gene %in% unique_to_rescue
  )

# pull loadings for later
unq_rescue_loadings = df_rescue %>% filter(in_set) %>% pull(PC2)

# plot ranks
barplot(deframe(select(df_rescue, PC2)))

# plot hits
ggplot(filter(df_rescue, in_set), aes(x = rank)) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(xend = rank, y = 0, yend = 1),
    color = "firebrick2",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, max(df_rescue$rank)))

# plot density

ggplot(df_rescue, aes(x = PC2, fill = in_set)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("FALSE" = "grey30", "TRUE" = "firebrick1"),
    labels = c("other DEGs", "118 rescue-unique DEGs")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "PC2 loading",
    y = "density",
    fill = NULL
  )




# repeat for a similarly-sized group, sham-unique 106 genes

unique_to_sham = setdiff(
  dea %>% filter(group == "sham_naive", sig == "up") %>% pull(Gene),
  dea %>% filter(group == "WT_naive", sig == "up") %>% pull(Gene)
)

# rank pc2 loadings and check if in 106
df_sham <- pca_loadings %>%
  select(Gene, PC2) %>%
  arrange(desc(PC2)) %>%
  mutate(
    rank = row_number(),
    in_set = Gene %in% unique_to_sham
  )

# pull loadings for later
unq_sham_loadings = df_sham %>% filter(in_set) %>% pull(PC2)

# plot density

ggplot(df_sham, aes(x = PC2, fill = in_set)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("FALSE" = "grey30", "TRUE" = "firebrick1"),
    labels = c("other DEGs", "106 sham-unique DEGs")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "PC2 loading",
    y = "density",
    fill = NULL
  )

# rescue-unique vs all other PCA genes
wilcox.test(
  unq_rescue_loadings,
  pca_loadings %>%
    filter(!Gene %in% unique_to_rescue) %>%
    pull(PC2)
)

# sham-unique vs all other PCA genes
wilcox.test(
  unq_sham_loadings,
  pca_loadings %>%
    filter(!Gene %in% unique_to_sham) %>%
    pull(PC2)
)

# rescue-unique vs sham-unique
wilcox.test(
  unq_rescue_loadings,
  unq_sham_loadings
)
```

```{r nested heatmap for grant}

df <- dea %>%
  filter(treatment == "IL1B")

# ============================================================================
# calculate rescue in wide format
# ============================================================================

df_wide <- df %>%
  filter(
    group %in% c(
      "WT_naive",
      "TAK1KO_naive",
      "TAK1KO_TAK1-smRNA",
      "TAK1KO_mTAK1-smRNA"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(Gene, group, log2fold) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = group,
    values_from = log2fold
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    
    # Fraction of the WT response remaining in KO
    ko_fraction = TAK1KO_naive / WT_naive,
    
    # Fraction of the WT response restored by native TAK1
    native_rescue = (
      `TAK1KO_TAK1-smRNA` - TAK1KO_naive
    ) / (
      WT_naive - TAK1KO_naive
    ),
    
    # Fraction of the WT response restored by D175A
    d175a_rescue = (
      `TAK1KO_mTAK1-smRNA` - TAK1KO_naive
    ) / (
      WT_naive - TAK1KO_naive
    )
  )

# ============================================================================
# define wt-responsive genes
# ============================================================================

wt_genes <- dea %>%
  filter(
    group == "WT_naive",
    sig == "up"
  ) %>%
  pull(Gene)

# ============================================================================
# define other categories using rescue fractions
# ============================================================================

# thresholds for defining KO loss and rescue
ko_threshold <- 0.75
native_rescue_threshold <- 0.25
d175a_rescue_threshold <- 0.25

rescue_category <- df_wide %>%
  filter(Gene %in% wt_genes) %>%
  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      
      ko_fraction <= ko_threshold &
        native_rescue >= native_rescue_threshold &
        d175a_rescue >= d175a_rescue_threshold ~
        "KO-sensitive\nboth rescued",
      
      ko_fraction <= ko_threshold &
        native_rescue >= native_rescue_threshold &
        d175a_rescue < d175a_rescue_threshold ~
        "KO-sensitive\nnative TAK1 rescued",
      
      ko_fraction <= ko_threshold &
        d175a_rescue >= d175a_rescue_threshold &
        native_rescue < native_rescue_threshold ~
        "KO-sensitive\nD175A rescued",
      
      ko_fraction <= ko_threshold ~
        "KO-sensitive\nnot rescued",
      
      TRUE ~
        "IL1B-upregulated\nKO-resistant"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    category = factor(
      category,
      levels = c(
        "IL1B-upregulated\nKO-resistant",
        "KO-sensitive\nnot rescued",
        "KO-sensitive\nnative TAK1 rescued",
        "KO-sensitive\nD175A rescued",
        "KO-sensitive\nboth rescued"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(category)

rownames(rescue_category) <- rescue_category$Gene

rescue_counts <- rescue_category %>%
  count(category)

# ============================================================================
# setup matrix
# ============================================================================

mat <- tpm %>%
  filter(
    treatment == "IL1B",
    Gene %in% wt_genes,
    group %in% c(
      "WT_naive",
      "TAK1KO_naive",
      "TAK1KO_TAK1-smRNA",
      "TAK1KO_mTAK1-smRNA"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sample = paste(group, rep)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(
      group,
      levels = c(
        "WT_naive",
        "TAK1KO_naive",
        "TAK1KO_TAK1-smRNA",
        "TAK1KO_mTAK1-smRNA"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(group) %>%
  select(Gene, sample, log2fold) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = sample,
    values_from = log2fold
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Gene") %>%
  as.matrix()

# make sure annotation order matches matrix
rescue_category <- rescue_category[
  rownames(mat),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

# ============================================================================
# build heatmap
# ============================================================================

hm = Heatmap(
  
  mat,
  name = "log2fold",
  
  col = generic_l2f_heatmap_colors(mat),
  
  row_split = rescue_category$category,
  row_title_rot = 0,
  row_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  show_row_dend = F,
  
  column_split = factor(
    c(rep("WT", 4), rep("KO", 4), rep("nat", 4), rep("D175A", 4)),
    levels = c("WT", "KO", "nat", "D175A")
  ),
  
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_row_slices = FALSE,
  clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2",
  
  show_row_names = FALSE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  
  border = "black"
  
)

png(
  filename = "nested heatmap.png", 
  width = 5, 
  height = 7, 
  units = "in", 
  res = 600
)

hm

dev.off()

# ============================================================================
# build pie chart
# ============================================================================

main_counts <- rescue_counts %>%
  summarise(
    `KO-resistant` = sum(n[grepl("KO-resistant", category)]),
    `KO-sensitive` = sum(n[grepl("KO-sensitive", category)])
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = "category",
    values_to = "n"
  )

ko_sensitive <- rescue_counts %>%
  filter(grepl("KO-sensitive", category)) %>%
  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      grepl("not rescued", category) ~ "Not rescued",
      grepl("native TAK1 rescued", category) ~ "Native TAK1 rescued",
      grepl("D175A rescued", category) ~ "D175A rescued",
      grepl("both rescued", category) ~ "Both rescued"
    ),
    category = factor(
      category,
      levels = c(
        "Not rescued",
        "Native TAK1 rescued",
        "D175A rescued",
        "Both rescued"
      )
    )
  )


colors <- c(
  "KO-resistant"        = "#073B4C",
  "KO-sensitive"        = "#118AB2",
  "Not rescued"         = "#6A4C93",
  "Native TAK1 rescued" = "#ffd166",
  "D175A rescued"       = "#EF476F",
  "Both rescued"        = "#06D6A0"
)

p_main <- ggplot(
  main_counts,
  aes(x = "", y = n, fill = category)
) +
  geom_col(
    width = 1,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  theme_void()


p_zoom <- ggplot(
  ko_sensitive,
  aes(x = "", y = n, fill = category)
) +
  geom_col(
    width = 0.25,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  theme_void()


p_main
p_zoom

ggsave("main pie.png", p_main, w = 4, h = 4, dpi = 600)
ggsave("zoom pie.png", p_zoom, w = 4, h = 4, dpi = 600)


# cleanup_objects()
```
